normalizedSubtitle: S.J.Res.12 — Use of Military Force Against Iran
rawSummary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune (R-SD) delivered a floor statement on May 28, 2026 in support of S.J.Res.12, authorizing limited use of military force against Iranian military targets. The resolution passed the Senate 61-37 on May 29, 2026. Thune voted Yea.
quote: This is a measured and constitutionally sound response to unprovoked aggression against American personnel and assets. We have a duty to stand with our troops and make clear that America will not tolerate attacks on its people.
